steps.en: OCMS picks hirers whose 2nd letter was sent and who are due a reminder.
steps.id: OCMS memilih hirer yang 2nd letter-nya sudah diproses dan waktunya diberi reminder.
steps.why_en: The reminder job is switched off in production, so this selection does not run there.
steps.why_id: Job reminder dimatikan di production, jadi pemilihan ini tidak berjalan di sana.

steps.en: Hirers who opted out of electronic reminders are skipped.
steps.id: Hirer yang memilih tidak menerima reminder elektronik dilewati.
steps.why_en: The check exists but runs inside the reminder job, which is switched off in production.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan ada, tetapi berjalan di dalam job reminder yang dimatikan di production.

steps.en: OCMS refreshes the hirer's mobile number or email before the reminder.
steps.id: OCMS menyegarkan nomor mobile atau email hirer sebelum reminder.
steps.why_en: The refresh from the government data source is switched off, so only stored contact details are used.
steps.why_id: Penyegaran dari sumber data pemerintah dimatikan, jadi hanya kontak yang tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: Hirers without a usable phone number or email are skipped.
steps.id: Hirer tanpa nomor telepon atau email yang bisa dipakai dilewati.
steps.why_en: The check is correct but runs only inside the reminder job, which is off in production.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan sudah benar tetapi hanya jalan di job reminder yang mati di production.

steps.en: Individual hirers with valid contact details go into the SMS batch.
steps.id: Hirer individu dengan kontak valid masuk ke batch SMS.
steps.why_en: The reminder job and SMS sending are both switched off in production.
steps.why_id: Job reminder dan pengiriman SMS sama-sama dimatikan di production.

steps.en: Company hirers with a valid email go to the email reminder.
steps.id: Hirer company dengan email valid masuk ke email reminder.
steps.why_en: The email for this stage is deliberately skipped, so company hirers get no reminder email.
steps.why_id: Email untuk stage ini sengaja dilewati, jadi hirer company tidak menerima email reminder.
